code_blocks.code:
TABLE 
    maturity AS "Maturity",
    confidence AS "Confidence",
    next-review AS "Next Review",
    review-count AS "Reviews"
WHERE file = this.file

> TABLE type, maturity
> FROM "03-notes"
> WHERE maturity = "evergreen" AND source = "claude-sonnet-4.5"
>

rows: `TABLE confidence, created WHERE maturity = "evergreen" AND confidence = "high"`
`TABLE created, source WHERE maturity = "seedling" AND created >= date(today) - dur(7 days)`
`TABLE created, maturity WHERE created < date(today) - dur(90 days)`
`TABLE modified, type WHERE modified >= date(today) - dur(7 days)`
`TABLE created WHERE created >= date(2025-12-01) AND created <= date(2025-12-13)`
`TABLE source, created WHERE type = "report" AND contains(source, "claude" OR "gemini")`
`TABLE next-review WHERE type = "reference" AND next-review < date(today)`
`TABLE source, type GROUP BY source WHERE contains(source, "gemini" OR "claude")`
`TABLE tags[0] AS "Primary Tag", length(rows) GROUP BY tags[0]`
`TABLE length(file.inlinks) AS "Inlinks" WHERE length(file.inlinks) > 5 SORT length(file.inlinks) DESC`
`TABLE length(file.inlinks) AS "In", length(file.outlinks) AS "Out" SORT length(file.inlinks) DESC`
`TABLE next-review, review-count WHERE next-review < date(today) SORT next-review ASC`
`TABLE review-count, maturity WHERE review-count > 0 SORT review-count DESC LIMIT 10`
`TABLE next-review, maturity WHERE maturity = "seedling" AND next-review > date(today)`
`TABLE round(average(review-count), 1) AS "Avg Reviews" GROUP BY maturity`
`TABLE length(rows) AS "Count" GROUP BY month SORT month DESC`
`TABLE length(rows) AS "Count" GROUP BY source SORT length(rows) DESC`
`FLATTEN tags TABLE length(rows) AS "Uses" GROUP BY tags SORT length(rows) DESC LIMIT 20`
